area: City Walk (45 Al Safa St); a Dubai Marina branch is also mentioned

avoid_dishes.reason: Probably a shared fryer (OK for you, but note it).

name: Massimo's Italian Restaurant
questions: What flours are in the GF pizza dough? Is there any oat flour?
What brand of GF pasta do you use?
Is the GF pizza baked on a tray or screen, or directly on the shared oven floor?
Do the GF bread and the pasta sauces contain any flour or roux?
quinoa_oat_flags: The ingredients of the GF pizza base are unknown. Ask whether it contains oat flour.

safe_dishes.dish: Gluten-free pizza (e.g. turkey ham and rocket)
safe_dishes.note: Reviewers call the GF dough crunchy yet soft, and one called it 'the best in Dubai'.
Listed, but reviewers rate it below the pizza. The brand is unknown.

summary: Only user reviews on Atly support this place, and they consistently praise the GF pizza at City Walk; the reviews are undated and I found no official menu.
